title: Every kind of step, on one deck

steps.path: The strip under the message box
steps.headline: A red block appeared under the message box.
steps.changed: A red block was painted where the strip was empty before.
steps.notice: There is something in the strip now instead of blank space.
steps.risk: The strip has room for one block and no more.

steps.path: The strip under the message box
steps.headline: Which of these two views should the strip show?
steps.notice: Whichever you pick is the view every screen uses.
steps.risk: Both keep the strip exactly where it is today.

variants.label: The middle of the screen
variants.summary: Shows the block where it sits, with room around it on both sides.

variants.label: The top corner
variants.summary: Shows the corner of the screen instead, which is empty today.

steps.path: The strip under the message box
steps.headline: Which side of the strip should the block sit on?
steps.notice: Whichever you pick is where it sits on every screen.
steps.risk: Nothing else in the strip moves whichever you pick.

options.label: The left end
options.summary: The block stays at the end of the strip it is at today.
pros: It is where your eye already is when you finish typing.
cons: It crowds the words that sit next to it.
options.cost: Nothing to build — it is where it is today.

options.label: The right end
options.summary: The block moves to the far end, on its own.
pros: Plenty of empty room around it, so it never crowds anything.
cons: It is further from where you were just looking.

steps.path: The strip under the message box
steps.headline: This is what done means for the block.

rows.statement: The block is painted in the place the picture shows.
The block can be told apart from the background at a glance.
rows.note: It could be a shade darker.

rows.statement: The block keeps its size at every window width.

steps.path: The strip under the message box
steps.headline: The block is red while it plays, where it used to be grey.
steps.changed: The recording on the right is the block after the change: red, not grey.
steps.notice: The colour is the only difference between the two recordings.
steps.risk: Colour on its own is hard to tell apart on the pale palette.

steps.path: The strip under the message box
steps.headline: Paint a second block in the corner of the strip.
steps.changed: A second block would be painted in the corner, where the strip is empty today.
steps.notice: The corner stops being blank, and the strip carries two things instead of one.
steps.risk: The corner is where the strip is narrowest, so a second block crowds it.
